definition: A compound that keeps chanda and rāga audible as coordinated but not identical factors.
notes: Use this record when the compound appears as a whole. Keep desire and passion distinct rather than flattening the phrase into one generic English word.

example_phrases.pali: Yo kho, āvuso visākha, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo taṁ tattha upādānan
example_phrases.translation: The desire and passion for the five heaps of appropriation, friend Visākha, is the taking personally there
example_phrases.notes: Keep the two terms distinct in English. SN 35.191 contains no `chandarāga`. Repaired 2026-08-21 in the inflected/inconclusive sweep.

example_phrases.translation: with judgement as condition, desire and passion
example_phrases.notes: A link in the DN 15 social-consequence chain.
